newsitem.title: UK: Euro vegoils lack interest in thin palm oil trade.
newsitem.headline: Euro vegoils lack interest in thin palm oil trade.

text.p: European vegetable oils traded a few small amounts of palm oil but otherwise lacked any real interest.
Firmer closes on both the Malaysian palm oil and Chicago soybean oil futures lent mild support to most of the market but did little else, traders said.
The palm oil sector saw trade on olein at $548.50, Oct/Dec at $550 and Aug/Dec at $547.50, while crude palm oil fetched $527.50 and $530/$529 for Jun and Oct/Dec respectively.
Lauric oils moved higher in sympathy with the slightly firmer palm oils. At midday the laurics were $2.50 to $5 up.
Soft oils at midday were tradeless with selling levels unchanged to one guilder down.
